macro_cross_check: FAILS by 80% on protein, and I am confident the cause is a BONE-BASIS defect in the engine rather than a wrong portion - flagging loudly rather than correcting a gram. Computed at source basis: 1814 g wings / 4 servings = 453 g per serving, which at the DB row (112 g = 210 cal, 20 P) gives 862 cal / 81.1 P / 2.4 C per serving against the source's published 620 cal / 45 P / 20 C. The 4 lb figure is the PURCHASE weight and includes bone; whole wings are roughly 45% bone. At a ~55% edible yield the recipe gives ~250 g edible per serving = 468 cal / 44.6 P, which lands on the source's 45 g protein almost exactly. So the recipe is real and in-band; the DB row for chicken wings is an edible-portion label being multiplied by a bone-in purchase weight. I have NOT reduced grams_source - 1814 g is the correct cost basis and reducing it would understate the shop. ACTION NEEDED: the wings row needs a bone-in basis or a yield factor, or this dish will compute at 862 cal and be retired against the 650 ceiling for a reason that is not true of the food. Carbs are safe either way at 2.4 g per serving. Second, smaller note: the 4 cups of pickle brine are a marinade that is discarded, so the 572 g of Dill Pickles macros (102 cal, 20 C) should not be counted as eaten even though the purchase is real.
